title: Cisco RV340 set_snmp usmUserEngineID Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Cisco RV340 routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of JSON-RPC requests. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the www-data user.
